The '''Jilrua system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the immediate vicinity of the [[Oktos Nebula/Legends|Oktos Nebula]], as part of the [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]] portion of [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]]. It contained a [[Blue giant/Legends|blue giant]] [[Star/Legends|star]] which was [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] by the [[Desert/Legends|desert]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Jilrua]], [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Jilruan/Legends|Jilruan]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Jilrua system was first mentioned in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', a [[2009]] reference book co-authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed it within grid square R-12.<ref name="TEA" />
